carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to a shadow-cast gradient immediately ventral, extending from the mid-body towards the caudal peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch is visible on the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin near the apex. The second dorsal fin shows a slight indentation on its anterior margin.
